assertions.assertion: Agent does not change the flight.
assertions.rationale: The agent never changed the flight. In [6] and [8], the agent explicitly stated that basic economy flights cannot be modified, offered alternatives (cancel/rebook or transfer to human), and ultimately transferred the user to a human agent in [10]-[12] without making any changes to reservation EUJUY6.

summary: The agent refused to change the flight, consistent with the basic economy policy, and transferred the user to a human agent.
